configuration.title: TerraMind
configuration.analyzerUrl: Base URL for the local TerraMind analyzer service.
configuration.generationModel: Model name already installed in the local Ollama instance.
configuration.generationEngine: Local generation engine used by the analyzer: auto selects the best available engine, ollama uses your local Ollama instance, transformers uses the bundled in-process model, and gguf loads a local .gguf file.
configuration.ggufModelPath: Absolute path to a local .gguf model file for the bundled gguf generation engine. Used by the analyzer only when the generation engine is set to gguf.
configuration.runExternalTools: Run installed Terraform fmt/validate, TFLint, and Checkov during analysis, and validate generated drafts against an existing local provider cache. Disabled by default and skipped in VS Code Restricted Mode; validation may execute provider plugins, and TerraMind never runs init, plan, or apply.
